title: Daughter of Chaos
start: Speak to Adrasteia in the Falador castle throne room.

recommended.t: Wilderness sword 1 or better for teleporting to Edgeville or activated Edgeville lodestone
Falador Teleport, activated Falador lodestone, ring of respawn, or master archaeologist's outfit to get to the White Knights' Castle

kills.t: Scaled, safe combat encounters where you control Moia with unique abilities. You cannot bring food, equipment, or Summoning familiars.
Part 1: 3 chaos demons, 3 chaos witches, and 3 Zamorakian cultists
Part 2: 2 chaos demons, 2 chaos witches, and 2 Zamorakian cultists

rewards.t: Order of Dis weapon cosmetic overrides
Order of Dis Blade and its off-hand variant
Order of Dis May(ce) and its off-hand variant
5% increased damage dealt to monsters in the Wilderness

steps.t: Talk to Adrasteia in the White Knights' Castle's throne room (floor 2, east side). [Chat: Accept › 2 I'll see it done.]
p: Adrasteia stands near the Saradomin's throne.

steps.t: Talk to Anne Dimitri downstairs 1 floor in the interrogation room (floor 1, centre). [Chat: Any]
Cross the Wilderness wall north of the Grand Exchange underwall tunnel.

sub.t: Make sure PVP is turned off. Most of the quest takes place in instances.

steps.t: Talk to Anne Dimitri. [Chat: 1 I'm ready.]
Talk to Anne Dimitri again after arriving at the abandoned camp.
p: Anne Dimitri is channelling a spell to the faded memory in the abandoned camp.
Moia appeared in the forward camp.
General Khazard, Moia, and Enakhra were in the forward camp.

steps.t: Investigate 3 points of interest. (yellow dots on minimap)
Interact with the Restored Memory twice. Make sure to have dismissed your familiar.

sub.t: Talk to Bilrach in the west.
You have Vault, Drain, and Blast abilities that you can trigger with the buttons on your screen (not the ability bar).
Use Vault to escape the area of effect of chaos rifts.
Use Drain as often as possible for healing. This ability is channelled. Moia will be uncommanded for a brief time by running to the target as this ability needs to be use semi-close to the enemy.
Use Blast as often as possible near enemies to deal extra damage.
If you die, you can lower the combat difficulty at any point of the quest when restarting the battle at Anne Dimitri in Wilderness.
Optionally, use the health orbs after killing any of the 9 required enemies.

p: Anne Dimitri is channelling a spell to the faded memory on Red Dragon Isle.
Anne Dimitri found a broken portal to Infernal Source.

steps.t: Talk to Anne Dimitri. [Chat: 4 We should move on.]
Interact with the Restored Memory twice.

sub.t: Kill the 6 enemies as in the previous section.
Talk to the wounded cultist in the south-western corner of the isle.
Kill Avaryss, the Unceasing using the abilities as in previous sections. She periodically summons two greater demons that can be killed for health orbs.

p: Moia confronts Avaryss, the Unceasing in Infernal Source.

steps.t: Talk to Trindine. [Chat: 2 I'll report back to Adrasteia.]
p: Trindine leaves the source and goes back to the Wilderness.
Now it's time for the world to struggle against me.
Moia opened a rift and escaped through it.

steps.t: Talk to Adrasteia in the White Knights' Castle's throne room (floor 2, east side).
